description: The app window and its small ones (the same app on tray.html: the tray flyout, the right-click menu on tray.html?menu, and the quick-capture popup on tray.html?capture): core defaults, plus opening http(s) links in the system browser (lib/platform.ts openExternal). Updates in place (lib/appUpdate.ts installUpdate). The web app talks to Supabase over HTTPS itself; the tray commands are the app's own (src/tray.rs).
